clean_summary: Recent works demonstrate that image and video generators display zero-shot visual understanding behaviors, similar to the emergent capabilities of language understanding and reasoning seen in large language models (LLMs) following generative pretraining. This suggests that these generators can learn and generalize visual tasks without specific training for each task.

title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows

clean_summary: Diffusion and flow-based models are now the standard methods for generating continuous data, such as images and videos, and there is increasing interest in their application to language modeling. However, existing approaches often struggle with the discrete nature of language data. This paper introduces Embedded Language Flows (ELF), which integrates continuous flow-based models with discrete language data by embedding the discrete tokens into a continuous space. The proposed method shows improved performance on language modeling tasks compared to traditional methods, demonstrating the potential of flow-based models in natural language processing.
